definitions.explanation: the practice of separating garbage into different categories for proper disposal and recycling

examples.japanese: ゴミ{分別|ぶんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかりする→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ゴミ{分別|ぶんべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The garbage sorting rules are strict in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧ゴミ{分別|ぶんべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: After coming to Japan, I learned how difficult garbage sorting can be.

notes:
GARBAGE CATEGORIES IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{燃|も}えるゴミ→燃えるゴミ：17105_moerugomi⟧ / ⟦{可燃|かねん}→可燃：26077_kanen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ - burnable garbage
- ⟦{燃|も}えないゴミ→燃えないゴミ：23525_moenaigomi⟧ / {不燃|ふねん}⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ - non-burnable garbage
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ - recyclables
- ⟦{粗大|そだい}ゴミ→粗大ゴミ：08045_sodaigomi⟧ - oversized garbage
- {危険物|きけんぶつ} - hazardous waste

CULTURAL NOTE:
Garbage sorting rules vary significantly by municipality in Japan and can be very detailed. New residents often receive guidebooks explaining local rules. Proper sorting is considered a civic duty.
